Implemented an O(n α(n)) duplicate detector using per-key indexing plus union-find, so `find_duplicates` and `drop_duplicates` no longer do quadratic pairwise scans.

I also kept the public behavior the same:
- same normalization rules
- same transitive grouping
- same group ordering and record ordering
- same error handling for keys
